name: com.oreethehat.easy-game-framework
description: Twelve integrated game-development modules: movement, combat, interaction, building, resources, feedbacks, input, UI, localization, saving, URP settings and a small shared core.

samples.description: A self-contained playable example connecting all modules. Import, create the scene from Tools > EasyGameFramework > Examples, then Play.
